overviewHtml:
Overview of Annapurna Sunrise View Tour

The Annapurna Sunrise View Tour is one of the most beautiful short adventures in Nepal, perfect for travelers seeking spectacular Himalayan scenery without the challenges of long treks. This Annapurna Sunrise Tour takes you to the world-famous Sarangkot (1592 m), the best viewpoint for a breathtaking sunrise over the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges. From the top, witness the glowing peaks of Annapurna South, Machhapuchhre (Fishtail), Hiunchuli, and Nilgiri as the first rays of the sun illuminate the snow-capped mountains an unforgettable experience that defines the beauty of Nepal.

Starting from the scenic city of Pokhara, the journey passes through charming Gurung and Magar villages, such as Australian Camp (2060 m), surrounded by rhododendron forests and terraced hillsides. This short Annapurna sunrise trek and tour is suitable for all age groups and fitness levels, making it ideal for families, couples, or first-time trekkers. The trail offers a perfect blend of cultural exploration, natural beauty, and panoramic mountain views, all within just a few days.

The highlight of the Annapurna Sunrise View Tour is undoubtedly the early morning drive to Sarangkot Viewpoint (1592 m), where you can capture the mesmerizing Annapurna sunrise view and enjoy a 360-degree panorama of the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges. Besides the scenic beauty, visitors can experience warm local hospitality, traditional Nepali cuisine, and authentic mountain village life along the way.

The best time for the Annapurna Sunrise View Tour

During autumn (September–November) and spring (March–May), when the weather is clear, the views are at their best. Winter also offers crisp skies, though colder mornings.

At Nepal Unique Treks, we offer a well-planned Annapurna Sunrise View Tour package that includes guided hikes, comfortable accommodation, transportation, and all necessary arrangements. Whether you are looking for a short Annapurna trek from Pokhara or a relaxing Himalayan holiday, this trip promises the perfect balance of comfort, adventure, and stunning sunrise photography opportunities.

Highlights of Annapurna Sunrise View Tour

  • Spectacular sunrise view from Poon Hill

  • Panoramic Himalayan vistas of Annapurna and Dhaulagiri

  • Cultural experience in the Dhampus villages
  • Easy and short trek from Pokhara, ideal for beginners

Annapurna Sunrise View Tour Itinerary

The Annapurna Sunrise View Tour Itinerary offers an extraordinary blend of Himalayan scenery, cultural exploration, and short, scenic hikes designed for travelers who want to experience the best of Nepal in comfort and style. This itinerary beautifully combines Kathmandu Valley Day Tours, Pokhara exploration, and short hikes to Australian Camp, Dhampus Village, and the Sarangkot viewpoint, providing a perfect balance of adventure and relaxation.

Your journey begins in Kathmandu, the cultural heart of Nepal, where you’ll explore the ancient heritage sites of the Kathmandu Valley, including Pashupatinath Temple, Boudhanath Stupa, Swayambhunath (Monkey Temple), and the historic Durbar Square. These UNESCO World Heritage Sites reflect the country’s rich history, art, and spiritual traditions. After soaking in the cultural essence of Kathmandu, a scenic drive or flight takes you to Pokhara, the serene lake city nestled beneath the majestic Himalayas.

Pokhara Valley Sightseeing

The real adventure begins with a short drive to Kande, followed by a pleasant hike to Australian Camp. This easy trail passes through lush forests and local settlements, offering stunning views of Annapurna South, Machhapuchhre (Fishtail), and Hiunchuli. The peaceful environment and breathtaking panoramas make Australian Camp a perfect introduction to the Himalayan landscape. Continuing the next day, the trail gently descends to Dhampus Village, a picturesque Gurung settlement known for its traditional houses, terraced fields, and warm local hospitality. The sunset and sunrise views from Dhampus are equally mesmerizing, revealing the full grandeur of the Annapurna range.

Returning to Pokhara, the itinerary includes Pokhara Valley sightseeing, covering major attractions like Phewa Lake, Davis Falls, Gupteshwor Cave, and the World Peace Pagoda. These landmarks showcase the natural beauty and tranquil charm of this lakeside city. The highlight of the tour comes with an early morning excursion to Sarangkot Viewpoint, the most famous sunrise spot near Pokhara. As dawn breaks, the golden rays of the sun paint the Himalayan peaks in brilliant shades of orange and pink — a truly unforgettable moment.

Combining cultural discovery, light hiking, and spectacular Himalayan views, the Annapurna Sunrise View Tour itinerary is ideal for families, couples, and travelers seeking a short yet enriching Nepal experience. With Nepal Unique Treks, every detail is thoughtfully arranged to ensure a comfortable, scenic, and memorable journey.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu 1345m
itinerary.description: Nepal Unique Treks staff will welcome you to Kathmandu International Airport. 6.5 km drive and check in to the Hotel. Overnight Sleep at Hotel.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu Valley Sightseeing 1346m, 5 hrs
itinerary.description: Dil gurung will visit you at your Hotel to complete our travel agreement, sign up, and fulfill official documents. Introduce a Tour guide who will help you to explore Kathmandu Valley sights and heritage. Today you will visit, Swayambhunath, Bouddhanath, Pashupatinath, Patan Durbarsquire, and return to the Hotel. Further trek, tour preparation, and welcome dinner.

itinerary.title: Fly to Pokhara and Drive to Kande and hike to Australian Camp
itinerary.description: After breakfast drive to Kathmandu domestic airport then 30 30-minute flight to Pokhara International Airport. during the flight enjoy with scenic Annapurna mountain view. From the airport, 1 hrs a one-hour drive to Kande and 1 hrs hike up to the Australian camp. Today you feel a relaxation because you moved directly from the city to the Mountain. Beautiful atmosphere, peace, and a nice clean environment with less humidity with a stunning sunset view and Annapurna mountain view. Overnight stay at guest house.

itinerary.title: Hike to Dhampus village drive to Pokhara 810
itinerary.description: Early morning enjoy with beautiful sunrise view and mesmerizing Annapurna Himalayan view. Enjoy breakfast in the open sky. Start hiking to Dhampus village. Dhampus Village is a tourist hub because you can explore beautiful mountain views, local people's lifestyles, lovely Gurung people, and there is interesting culture. Dhampus Village is near from City which is why many domestic tourist and foreign tourists come to Dhampus Village to spend overnight. But we didn't stay in the village because last night we spent time in the Australian Base Camp we will go to Pokhara for a luxurious stay. Overnight stay in Lakeside Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Pokhara Valley Sightseeing 810m, 5 hrs
itinerary.description: Today we will learn about local religion, culture, mountain people's lifestyle, flora fauna, and Geographical view of Nepal Himalayan. After breakfast in the Hotel, start sightseeing with a tour guide and a safe drive. Today you will visit the World Peace Stupa, David Falls, Mahendra Cave, International Mountain Museum, and Taal Barahi Temple. at early afternoon back to the hotel and relax. Dinner in the lakeside and Overnight sleep at lakeside Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Sarangkot viewpoint, Fight to Kathmandu and drive to Nagarkot 2175m
itinerary.description: Early in the morning, 5 am, 40 m drive to Sarangkot viewpoint, from there you can see more than 20 snow peaks with a stunning sunrise view. It will be a lovely morning very joyful and romantic morning, coffee with a dramatic Mountain view. Drive back to the Hotel. After breakfast drive to International Airport in Pokhara and a 30 m mountain flight bring you to Kathmandu Domestic Airport. 30 km far away from the Airport to Nagarkot. One and a half hours drive by private car. Check-in at Hotel Country Villa and feel the luxurious stay and delicious taste of Himalayan food in a foreign style. In the evening enjoy the hike around the local village. Beautiful sunset hit the Langtang Himalaya making a romantic and mesmerizing view. Overnight stay at Hotel Country Villa.

itinerary.title: Drive to Kathmandu thought Bhaktapur and Patan Durbar squire 1345m.
itinerary.description: Enjoy the breakfast with a beautiful mountain view. 40 m drive from Nagarkot to Bhaktapur. You may enjoy the sightseeing in UNESCO WORLD HERITAGE SITES Bhaktapur and Patan. The tour guide will tell you in detail. You may enjoy and explore a few hours in Bhaktapur and Patan. Check-in Hotel in Thamel Kathmandu. In the early evening, you are invited to the Farewell dinner in Thamel. Sharing the Trekking and Nepal Tour Experience. You will awarded and congratulation for the successful trip. After dinner, you may be free to host your lovely night if you like to explore the Nightlife in Thamel.

itinerary.title: Departure to International Airport 1345m.
itinerary.description: Departure to International Airport from Hotel. Three hours before then your flight schedule.
